authorityReview.evidence: Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 deposit(uint256 assets,address receiver) is admitted. Its inherited body checks assets against maxDeposit(receiver), calculates shares through WOETH's overridden preview/conversion methods, transfers the contract-configured OETH asset from msg.sender with safeTransferFrom, mints shares to caller-selected receiver, and returns shares. WOETH's conversions and totalAssets use OETH rebasing credits and its initialized adjuster; totalAssets is not raw token balance, and donated OETH is ignored by that accounting model. The configured asset, OETH rebasing-credit state, adjuster initialization, rounding/overflow, ERC20 allowance/balance, receiver validity, and token/protocol behavior can affect or revert execution. Policy adds no amount, receiver/owner equality, balance, oracle, or financial gate; zero, arbitrary receiver, and full uint256 values are ABI-policy permitted but may be rejected or revert in protocol execution. Approval is separate and not paired or granted. This admission is only deposit and does not establish an OETH-to-ETH exit workflow, current proxy/storage/asset initialization, liquidity, funded execution, or financial safety.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 mint(uint256 shares,address receiver) is admitted. Its body checks shares against maxMint(receiver), calculates required assets through WOETH's overridden preview/conversion methods (including inherited rounding-up behavior), safeTransferFroms the fixed configured OETH asset from msg.sender, mints exactly the requested shares to caller-selected receiver, and returns assets. WOETH's conversions and totalAssets use OETH rebasing credits and initialized adjuster, not raw OETH balance; donated OETH is ignored by the modeled accounting. Configured asset, OETH rebasing-credit state, adjuster initialization, rounding/overflow, ERC20 allowance/balance, receiver validity, and protocol/token behavior can affect or revert execution. Policy imposes no share/asset amount, receiver/owner equality, balance, oracle, or financial gate; ABI-valid zero/arbitrary receiver and uint256 values remain permitted but may fail protocol checks. Approval remains separate and is neither paired nor granted. This method alone is not a complete workflow and dated source/deployment evidence does not prove current proxy/storage/asset configuration, liquidity, funded execution, or financial safety.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 withdraw(uint256 assets,address receiver,address owner) is admitted. Its body checks assets against maxWithdraw(owner), derives required shares via previewWithdraw and WOETH's rebasing-credit/adjuster conversions, spends ERC20 allowance when msg.sender differs from caller-selected owner (unless allowance is uint256 max), burns the shares from owner, and transfers the fixed configured OETH asset to caller-selected receiver. It returns shares burned. Configured OETH/adjuster/accounting, owner share balance and allowance, receiver validity, token behavior and protocol conditions can revert execution. The platform does not require owner to equal execution owner/caller and adds no asset amount, receiver, balance, oracle or financial gate; ABI-valid zero/arbitrary owners/receivers and full uint256 values are policy-permitted but protocol validation applies. No approval is paired or granted. Withdrawal returns OETH, not native ETH, and this method does not promise liquidity or a complete workflow. Dated evidence does not establish current proxy/storage, asset configuration, initialization, funded execution or financial safety.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 redeem(uint256 shares,address receiver,address owner) is admitted. Its body checks shares against maxRedeem(owner), calculates OETH through WOETH's rebasing-credit/adjuster conversion, spends ERC20 allowance when msg.sender differs from caller-selected owner (unless allowance is uint256 max), burns shares from owner, and transfers the fixed configured OETH asset to caller-selected receiver. It returns OETH assets. Configured asset/OETH rebasing-credit state/adjuster accounting, owner share balance and allowance, receiver validity, token behavior and protocol conditions may affect or revert execution. Policy does not require owner to equal caller/execution owner and adds no share/asset amount, receiver, balance, oracle or financial gate; ABI-valid zero/arbitrary owner/receiver values and full uint256 values remain permitted but protocol logic may reject them. No approval is paired or granted. Redemption is for OETH, not native ETH, and is not a complete workflow or liquidity guarantee. Dated evidence does not establish current proxy/storage/configuration, funded execution or financial safety.
